rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: An SPA release datelined Riyadh 3 Rabi al-Awwal 1438 / 2 December 2016 says royal orders were issued that day.
rows.locator: data.content: dateline and opening sentence; trailer 22:00 Makkah time

rows.holder_name: Abdullah bin Mohammed bin Ibrahim Al Al-Sheikh
rows.printed_name: عبدالله بن محمد بن إبراهيم آل الشيخ
rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Royal Order A/54 dated 3/3/1438 AH, issued by King Salman bin Abdulaziz, constitutes the Shura Council of 'معالي الشيخ الدكتور عبدالله بن محمد بن إبراهيم آل الشيخ ـ رئيساً ـ' and named members for four Hijri years beginning 3/3/1438 AH; it recites A/45 of 29/2/1434.
rows.locator: data.related_news entry f5158ca753 (seventh addition): order number, date, recitals and item First; the list ends with item Second in entry 90a9d63bcf

rows.text: Under A/54 the new four-year term begins on 3/3/1438 AH, the Hijri day of the order, which the release's dateline equates with 2 December 2016.
rows.locator: Item First of A/54 with the release dateline

bounded_scope: Chair observations for CLAUDE-C01-25 only (sa_shura_chair and sa_succession_chair). Appointment orders, stated effective days, stated first days in office, oaths, council-formation orders, term starts and openings, acting presiding, deaths, translations, republications and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The C01-06 king, crown-prince and prime-minister roles are outside this extract.
